note: Brunei Darussalam, read on the Immigration and National Registration Department's own pages (immigration.gov.bn) on 2026-10-30. A work pass is endorsed on a visa approval and the employer's licence to take and employ foreign workers (the Labour Department's), extended on renewal, and a change of employer needs a new endorsement (read as work for the sponsor; where it is first applied for isn't said, either). The Entry Permit section processes applications for permanent resident status (from 31 December 2024 under the Ministry of Home Affairs' published categories, not read); the permit card on approval costs BND 50 or BND 5 by nationality, which the form's single fee doesn't hold. The work pass's fee and term, and the years naturalisation asks, aren't on the pages read.
